metadata.description: Claude Code mods for day-to-day development: safety guard, auto checks, notifications, usage status, dashboard, team pipeline, standup and a cat assistant

plugins.name: dev-guard
plugins.description: Blocks catastrophic commands, asks before risky ones, and stops secrets from being written into files

plugins.name: auto-check
plugins.description: Runs the project's linter after each edit and its type-checker before Claude stops, handing failures back to Claude

plugins.name: done-notify
plugins.description: Sound, toast and macOS notification when a long turn finishes or Claude is waiting for you

plugins.name: dev-status
plugins.description: Colored progress bars under the prompt for context, 5-hour and 7-day limits with reset times and cost, plus a /usage-bars view

plugins.name: dev-dashboard
plugins.description: A live pane of this session: files edited, recent commands, checks, denials, turns and usage

plugins.name: team-flow
plugins.description: Band above the prompt showing the BA → Lead → Dev → Review → Sec pipeline from .team/ files

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: /standup: a Thai daily standup from today's git commits and this session's work

plugins.name: neko
plugins.description: แมวผู้ช่วย (Neko): นั่งเหนือช่องพิมพ์ คอยให้คำแนะนำระหว่างทำงาน และตอบคำถามผ่าน /neko
